key:<Space>dt.note: Shows or hides the right-hand panel, remembered. OperatorTodoList {closed_since} every 5 s; open items most urgent then newest, NEW and closed-since-last-visit highlights from the remembered last visit, the open/hidden choice and the visit kept in localStorage; a ☐ N todo +new ✓closed badge in the top bar (click toggles). The desktop shows the panel whenever it is open (its detail pane is always on screen)

key:<Space>dj.note: Next item; a hidden panel opens first, as in the TUI

key:<Space>dk.note: Previous item; a hidden panel opens first

key:<Space>do.location: src/actions/todo.ts, src/actions/todo-run.ts, src/todo.ts, src/todo-model.ts, src-tauri/src/todo.rs, src-tauri/src/nav.rs
key:<Space>do.note: issue:#N opens the Issues workspace at that Issue, session:<uuid> opens the session (switching to Archived when needed), an http(s) URL opens in the system browser (open_url, G2), falling back to the clipboard when no opener runs

key:<Space>dd.note: Opens the pop-up on its y/n prompt; y/Enter sends OperatorTodoClose {todo_id, status: done, note: null}, the item leaves at once and <Space>du undoes it for 60 s

key:<Space>dx.note: Opens the pop-up on its y/n prompt; y/Enter sends OperatorTodoClose with status dismissed; undoable for 60 s

key:<Space>dy.note: Copies the item's command text verbatim; the toast is the TUI's 'Copied to-do command: …'

key:<Space>dv.note: Opens the selected item in the pop-up

key:<Space>du.note: OperatorTodoReopen {todo_id} for the latest close inside 60 s; the restored item is selected and a read that started before it is dropped

key:<Space>da.note: Caught up: clears the highlights and moves the baseline to now

overlay-ref:to-do-pop-up.note: Full title, priority, source, age, link and the complete command; y yank, d done?, x dismiss?, u undo, o open link, n/p next/previous, j/k and Up/Down scroll, Ctrl-D/Ctrl-U ten rows, g/Home top, q/Esc close; at the prompt y/Enter confirm, n/Esc/q cancel; Space N / Space ; leave it
